title: Muddy Puddles
hook: 下雨天不能出门，雨一停 Peppa 和 George 就冲进花园，跳进一个又一个泥坑。

cells.a: It was rainy. They could not play outside.
cells.cn: 那天下雨，他们不能在外面玩。

cells.a: She asked, “Can we go out to play?”
cells.cn: 她问爸爸能不能出去玩。

cells.a: She loved jumping in muddy puddles.
She said, “You must wear your boots.”
cells.cn: 妈妈说：“你必须穿上雨靴。”

cells.a: She looked after her little brother, George.

cells.q: What did Peppa find in the garden?
cells.a: She found a really big puddle.
cells.cn: 她在花园里找到一个超大的泥坑。

cells.a: She checked if the puddle was safe for George.
cells.cn: 她先确认这个泥坑对弟弟安不安全。

cells.a: He guessed they jumped in muddy puddles.
cells.cn: 爸爸猜到他们去跳泥坑了。

cells.q: What did the whole family do at last?
cells.a: They all jumped in muddy puddles.
cells.cn: 最后一家人都跳进了泥坑。

ending: In the end, the whole family jumps in muddy puddles together. My favourite part is ______.
